Bounded base64 envelope for a user attachment.

The service decodes and MIME-sniffs the bytes before an artifact is
published.  The encoded payload is never written to the durable job.

ModelDownloadRequest.description:
Download a GGUF file by direct URL or Hugging Face repo id into the
configured models directory. Distinct from ModelPullRequest, which is
Ollama's registry-tag-pull concept and doesn't apply to GGUF files.
ModelDownloadRequest.title: ModelDownloadRequest

RecipeImageTransformRequest.description:
Explicit request for one qualified, fixed-function image transform.

The source artifact must already have been copied into the owner-scoped
artifact store by a trusted attachment boundary. The API accepts only the
opaque artifact ID and the typed recipe plan; it never accepts a path or
executable instruction.
RecipeImageTransformRequest.title: RecipeImageTransformRequest

post.description:
Stage one bounded image or text document for a chat turn.

The browser receives opaque metadata only.  Content is retained in the
owner-scoped local attachment store and is resolved only when the
generation job starts.

schema.title: Response List Chat Groups Api V1 Chat Groups Get

delete.description:
Delete the group only. Its chats return to the ungrouped list --
tidying the sidebar must never destroy conversations.

schema.title: Response List Chats Api V1 Chats Get

get.description:
Return one owner-scoped, integrity-checked result artifact.

The UI receives bytes only after the repository re-checks retention,
location, size, and digest.  Neither the artifact path nor the source
filename is exposed to the browser.

post.description:
Stage one bounded attachment for a qualified recipe request.

The route accepts only a bounded base64 envelope.  Decoded bytes pass
through the same owner-scoped artifact boundary used by recipe output;
no caller path, filename, or executable instruction is accepted.
Queue one local Python run and pause until the user approves it.

Start one owner-scoped image recipe.

The route is intentionally unavailable unless the app was built with
an execution lifecycle that completed its health-gated startup.
Attachment staging is a separate trusted boundary; callers provide
only its opaque artifact identifier here.
Start one bounded calculation in the local worker profile.
